changes: Fix: Figures with clip art over a soil layer no longer stall PowerPoint, and Word's PDF keeps them sharp.
New: Pictures in a copied figure or an .emf get only the pixels their size needs; Options sets the resolution (300 dpi unless changed).
New: Copy as image (Home > Clipboard, or right-click) copies a plain picture; the status bar says when a copy is heavy for Office.
New: Drag a polyline's level or plumb segment sideways by its middle handle; the right angles stay.
MCP: export_clipboard takes format png; picture_dpi on EMF export and copy; move_segment works on lines.
